name: reproduction-artifacts
command: import json,hashlib,tarfile,subprocess; from pathlib import Path; root=Path.cwd(); px=root/"uav_lab/.local/checkouts/px4-raptor"; subprocess.run(["git","-C",str(px),"apply","--reverse","--check",str(root/"patches/raptor-final.patch")],check=True); lock=json.loads(Path("environment.lock").read_text()); binary=px/"build/px4_sitl_raptor/bin/px4"; sha=hashlib.sha256(binary.read_bytes()).hexdigest(); assert sha==lock["sources"]["raptor"]["binary_sha256"]; runs=list(Path("data").glob("verified-*/metadata.json")); assert all(json.loads(p.read_text())["binary_sha256"]==sha for p in runs); archive=tarfile.open("patches/raptor-final-untracked.tar.gz"); assert all(archive.extractfile(m).read()==(px/m.name).read_bytes() for m in archive.getmembers()); assert json.loads(Path("data/environment-20261009/research-apply-idempotence.json").read_text())["status"]=="PASS"; print("PASS: reverse patch check, source archive, idempotence, lock and",len(runs),"actual flight binaries")
